heroHeadline: MH17: ECHR Finds Russia Responsible — 298 Killed
heroSubtitle: In July 2025, the European Court of Human Rights issued a landmark ruling finding Russia legally responsible for downing MH17. Three suspects remain convicted in absentia by The Hague court (Nov 2022). Dutch court ruled in April 2026 that cabinet documents may remain secret. Families' advocate Piet Ploeg awarded royal knighthood.
footerNote: Data sourced from Dutch Safety Board, Joint Investigation Team, Netherlands District Court, European Court of Human Rights, Bellingcat, and major international outlets.
